map.数据 80, 90, 70, 100 的算术平均 = (80+90+70+100: The arithmetic mean of 80, 90, 70, 100 = (80+90+70+100)/4 = 340/4 = 85. Note that the mean can be pulled up or down by extreme values; when outliers are present, consider the median instead.
map.若三次测验权重分别为 0.2/0.3/0.5，成绩 80/90/70，则加权平均: If three tests have weights 0.2/0.3/0.5 and scores 80/90/70, the weighted average = 80×0.2+90×0.3+70×0.5 = 16+27+35 = 78, which emphasizes the higher-weighted test more than a simple average.
map.平均数是所有数之和除以个数，受极端值影响大；中位数是排序后居中那个数，对离群点稳: The mean is the sum divided by the count and is strongly affected by extreme values; the median is the middle value after sorting and is robust to outliers; the mode is the most frequent value. When the distribution is skewed these three diverge, so choose the right one for the situation.
map.为什么均值会被极端值影响？: Why is the mean affected by extreme values?
map.均值把每个数平等相加再除以个数，一个极大或极小的数会拉高或拉低总和，从而改变结果: The mean adds every value equally and divides by the count, so one very large or very small value shifts the total and changes the result; the median only depends on position, so it is unaffected by the magnitude of the extremes.
